scripts.install:frozen: bun install --frozen-lockfile && python -m pip install --require-hashes -r src/server/modules/requirements-dev.lock
scripts.format: biome format --write . && ruff format src/server/modules/prompt_enhancer evaluation
scripts.format:check: biome format . && ruff format --check src/server/modules/prompt_enhancer evaluation
scripts.lint: biome lint . && ruff check src/server/modules/prompt_enhancer evaluation
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: bun test src/protocol src/server src/client scripts && python -m pytest src/server/modules/prompt_enhancer evaluation/tests
scripts.test:protocol: bun test src/protocol src/server/config.test.ts src/server/lib/auth.test.ts src/server/lib/ws.test.ts src/server/lib/scheduler.test.ts src/client/lib/ws.test.ts src/client/events/fileop.test.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.gate:release: bun run check && bun run audit && bun run docs:check && bun run security:scan && bun run demo:record && bun run release:build && bun run release:validate
